subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: (R)PER.VT.U.FUND.-----MT.INFO.
description: Diagram opening MP(II)-6 — the section on State Department use of creative music as 'an accelerated political factor — and tool — since the middle forties.' This diagram pairs with the v2-p487 (PER.PHY.U.FUND × SPT.DYM) crossing on the preceding page; where p487 diagrammed the perceived physical universe fundamental meeting spiritual dynamics, this one diagrams the *vibrational* version of the same fundament meeting multi-information: (R)PER-VT-U-FUND (the reality of perceived vibrational universe fundamental) is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). PER-VT-U-FUND sits centrally with the subject-arrow, and the main line runs from it to MT-INFO at the right; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) rises from the main line, and STF (source transfer) branches from it to the upper-right. SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics) branches from the T-C-IMP line to the left; MOT-DY branches from the SPT-DYM line down to the lower-left, and IST-F (isolated focus) branches from the MOT-DY line, between SPT-DYM and PER-VT-U-FUND. LK-IMP (linkage implications, written 'lk.inp.') drops from the main line to the bottom; UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) branches from the LK-IMP line to the right margin, and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) branches from the UNF-PI line.
